nonlinear_residualiser: RandomForestRegressor fitted only on outer-training donors; max_depth=4, min_samples_leaf=3.
batch_location_adjustment: Training-only batch location centring; no empirical-Bayes scale shrinkage and therefore labelled ComBat-style rather than ComBat.
propensity_adjustment: Training-only logistic propensity model with clipped overlap weights.
bootstrap_scope: Paired resampling of repeat-level residualisation losses; matched restriction discrepancies are locked point estimates. Intervals are split-sensitivity intervals, not population confidence intervals.
